instagram.tone: Hook first. Community feel. Reel-friendly pacing.
instagram.notes: First 125 chars visible before more — make them count
hook_rules: First 125 chars are visible before 'more' — treat like a headline
Hook must stop the scroll before they read anything else

cta_by_bucket.Authority: Save CTA — 'Save this before you post again.'
cta_by_bucket.Conversion: Keyword CTA — 'Comment [WORD] and I'll DM you the resource.'

instagram.priority_metric: Saves drive distribution more than likes. End authority posts with save CTA.

youtube.tone: Depth. Let it breathe. Clear value promise upfront.

linkedin.tone: Thought leadership. Specific insight. No fluff.
linkedin.notes: Notes: Never start with I. No em-dashes. 3 hashtags max. Hook ≤210 chars before see more.
hook_rules: Use simple verbs with slight tension
End with ellipsis or open loop to force expansion
If hook needs context it is not a hook — draft body first, mine hook from middle
210 chars visible before see more — the hook IS the ad

hook_patterns.stop_start: Stop posting tips. Start posting transformations...
hook_patterns.myth_buster: Your algorithm issue is actually a positioning issue...
hook_patterns.number_result: From 0 to 18 qualified DMs in 10 days (same posting schedule)...
hook_patterns.personal_unexpected: Last night I had dinner with LinkedIn's CEO...
hook_patterns.how_i_without: How I grew with no viral post. Here's how that works...
hook_patterns.playbook_system: The 20-minute audit I run before every post...
hook_patterns.identity_challenge: You're writing like a blog. LinkedIn is not a blog...

writing_frameworks.AIDA: Attention→Interest→Desire→Action. Fast persuasive posts. Sharp hook, 1-2 lines proving pain, paint better state, CTA. Best for: Conversion bucket.
writing_frameworks.PAS: Problem→Agitate→Solve. Name pain, give concrete cost (time/money/energy), offer simple fix. Best for: Authority posts leading to resource or offer.
writing_frameworks.StoryArc: Setup→Conflict→Decision→Outcome→Lesson. 1-2 sentences per beat. Best for: Growth posts — career stories, client wins, failures, lessons.

cta_by_bucket.Growth: Question CTA or Binary Choice — sparks replies and debate. Example: 'Which step are you trying first?' or 'Smart or lazy? Drop your take.'
cta_by_bucket.Authority: Save CTA — drives bookmarks. Example: 'Save this for your next content sprint.' PRIORITY: algorithm currently rewards saves over reactions.
cta_by_bucket.Conversion: Keyword Reply CTA — drives comment volume and DMs. Example: 'Comment ENGINE and I'll send you the playbook.'

linkedin.priority_metric: SAVES — algorithm currently rewards saves above reactions. Authority posts must always end with a save CTA.

tiktok.notes: Hook must land in first 2 seconds
tiktok.hook_timing: Hook must land in first 2 seconds — use the most surprising or specific line
hook_rules: 0-2 seconds: most unexpected or specific claim
Script outline in bullet points, not paragraphs
Keep caption punchy — ≤5 words is ideal

facebook.notes: End with a question to drive comments
facebook.cta_rule: Always end with an explicit engagement question — comments drive distribution

newsletter.tone: Curated and warm. Make the reader feel like an insider.
structure: Hero story — 1 featured piece with context
This Week in Cre8te — 3-5 supporting clips/posts
Community spotlight — testimonial or ITL moment
CTA — join community / attend next event / share

content_buckets.strategy: Rotate intentionally across 3 buckets. Do not leave content mix to chance.

Growth.goal: Reach and discovery — attract new followers, trigger shares
what_works: Broad problems your audience relates to
Simple frameworks people can apply immediately

Authority.goal: Trust and proof — position as expert, drive saves and bookmarks
Authority.cta: Save CTA — PRIORITY metric right now

Conversion.goal: Leads and actions — move follower to subscriber/client/collaborator
what_works: Soft pitches with clear next step
Conversion.cta: Keyword Reply CTA drives comment volume and DM conversations

total_impressions.why: Shows reach trajectory and algorithm health

engagement_rate.why: Higher = content resonating. Lower = topic or hook problem

comments.why: Comments drive distribution more than likes

saves_bookmarks.why: High saves = authority content landing. PRIORITY metric

newsletter_signups.why: Bridge from social to owned audience
